name: Medicube K-beauty skincare hauls and routines
what_it_is: Creators show and demo Medicube skincare products: an airport travel prep to South Korea with the brand, body wash and peel shots, collagen and eye creams in a night routine, a discounted hypochlorous acid set, and a pink-vs-red lip balm stick comparison. Most are sponsored or brand-tagged demos rather than reactions to one event.
